about: Every published version of the LBK client plugin. Any change to the plugin's files needs a new version and a new entry here (src/__tests__/plugin-release.test.ts enforces it), then client-plugin/publish.sh. Clients who added the marketplace (hackeyzlife02/lbk-plugin) get it automatically; anyone who uploaded the plugin file has to upload the new one. Since 0.6.0 the skill holds LBK's answering rules (Anthropic Software Directory Policy 2.F: no rules pulled from a tool result at run time), so a rule change is a plugin release.

releases.changes: Invoices and payments cover the client's LBK projects only: the lbk-showroom skill says the records are the invoices LBK has tied to the client's Matterhaul jobs, with the payments and credits applied to them, and that older purchases or ones not on an LBK project aren't included (offer a showroom email for a full account statement). The README says the same. Requires connector 0.14.1.

Quote pages for your clients: a new section in the lbk-showroom skill (create_quote_page, update_quote_page, list_quote_pages and manage_quote_page_link: the client's own priced version of a published LBK quote for their customer, their cost times their markup worked out by the connector, on a 90-day link and a PDF; ask the markup when it's missing; present the preview as a room table with Your cost, Client price and Your margin; never compute prices; never put the client's cost in anything meant for their customer; versions for a contractor go to export_spec_package). Which tool for what, Prices and What goes through the showroom cover them. The README lists the feature and what a quote page keeps. Requires connector 0.14.0.

Spec sheets link opens a page: the lbk-showroom skill says the export_spec_package link opens a page (phone or computer) with each room's products and their Spec and Install documents, the whole PDF and a PDF per room, and that the first open can take up to two minutes. The README says what a spec sheets link keeps for 90 days (its page, PDFs, documents and small product pictures). Requires connector 0.13.1.

Invoices and payments: a new Invoices and payments section in the lbk-showroom skill (list_invoices, get_invoice and export_billing work only when LBK has turned them on for the client; amounts as written and sums only from totals or matchingTotals; as-of times and the payments_lag, stale, truncated and overdue_partial warnings; a pay link only for an open invoice and only the payUrl get_invoice returns; export_billing as a PDF for everything purchased with receipts; disputes, refunds, payment changes and tax go to the showroom; deposits, refund receipts and journal entries aren't in the records). Which tool for what and What goes through the showroom cover them. The README lists the feature and says what the connector keeps when invoices are on. Requires connector 0.13.0.

Spec sheets and installation instructions: the lbk-showroom skill routes requests for spec sheets, install instructions, product documents, submittals or documents for a plumber or contractor to export_spec_package (one PDF per quote, room by room, with a 90-day link anyone who has it can open), says what to tell the client and how to name missing documents, offers the quote in one line when the request could mean either, and names the new LBK view button message. The README lists the feature and says a spec sheets PDF is kept for 90 days and anyone with its link can open it. Requires connector 0.12.0.

Directory compliance (Anthropic Software Directory Policy 2.F and 2.G). The lbk-showroom skill now holds LBK's answering guide in plain text: where answers come from, the first reply, which tool for what (including the LBK views' button messages), finding products, LBK's brands, prices, quotes, exports, add-to-quote, what goes through the showroom and voice. It no longer defers to rules returned by get_my_account or ranks them above other instructions; get_my_account is only a source of facts (account, access, jobs, brandPreferences). The /lbk:price and /lbk:quotes commands no longer point at a guidance field, and the ChatGPT review case drops its mention of one. Requires connector 0.11.0, which removes the guidance field from get_my_account.
Names drain searches and lower-cost and finish-matched fixture options in the showroom skill. Brand-specific recommendations come from the connector’s live guidance.

Adds README.md inside the plugin folder (plugins/lbk). Anthropic's directory blocks a plugin folder without one and shows it as the listing text: what the plugin does, who can use it, how to install it, what it contains (the connector, the skill, two commands; nothing runs locally) and a data summary that matches lbksf.com/connect/privacy. No behavior change. First marketplace release since 0.4.0, so it also carries 0.5.0 (add-to-quote wording).

Add to quote: the listing, skill and README now say the connector is read-only except add-to-quote requests (when LBK turns them on for a client), which LBK reviews before anything changes on a quote. The no-approvals review case allows those requests. Requires connector 0.7.0. The skill stays thin; the add-to-quote rules live in the connector's guidance.

ChatGPT listing: shorter subtitle, three task-based starter prompts, support link, dark brand accent, and five positive plus three negative review cases. Optional compact product and quote views require connector 0.5.0 and a UI-capable host. The skill remains thin and defers to live connector guidance.

Crisp icon: assets/icon.png (512) and assets/logo.png (1024) re-rendered from the vector LBK monogram (brand/lbk-icon.svg) as a full-bleed, opaque navy square. Fixes the white corners and blur George saw.

Thin plugin: the skill and commands now say 'use LBK first, call get_my_account, follow its guidance'. All the detailed rules (what to use when, pricing, the showroom, voice) moved to the connector's live get_my_account guidance, so rule changes no longer need a plugin update. No spec book wording (from 0.2.1).
